Промпт для первого кадра

В разделе Design выберите Nano Banana или GPT Image, прикрепите фотографию персонажа и вставьте промпт.

Промпт · изображение
Create a photorealistic cinematic opening frame for a live-action fantasy film.

CHARACTER REFERENCE:
@image1 is the character reference sheet. Reproduce the woman’s exact facial identity, hair, skin tone, body proportions, and light-gray knitted sweater with matching sweatpants. Do not change or reinterpret her appearance.

SCENE:
A cozy, realistic living room at night. A brown leather sofa is positioned on the left side of the room. A modern television stands several feet in front of the sofa on the right side. A warm floor lamp creates soft amber ambient light.

The woman is sitting comfortably on the brown leather sofa. She holds one old black television remote in her right hand and points it directly toward the television. She is pressing the channel button and watching the screen with mild puzzled frustration.

CRITICAL SPATIAL COMPOSITION:
The television must be physically located IN FRONT OF the woman, directly along her gaze and in the exact direction of the remote.

The woman, her eyes, the remote, and the television must form one clear and physically correct visual axis.

The television must never appear behind the woman.

CAMERA:
Cinematic medium-wide 16:9 frame, eye-level camera, realistic 35mm lens.

Use a three-quarter side angle from the open side of the room. The camera must simultaneously show:

- The woman’s recognizable face in three-quarter profile.
- Her hand holding the black remote.
- The direction in which the remote is pointing.
- The visible television screen positioned in front of her.

The woman and sofa occupy the left half of the frame. The television occupies the right half and faces toward her. Keep enough visible floor space between the sofa and television to make their positions completely unambiguous.

TELEVISION SCREEN:
The screen displays a breathtaking photorealistic fantasy landscape with floating green islands, distant waterfalls, luminous clouds, and warm golden light. All fantasy imagery remains contained inside the television screen. No magic has entered the living room yet.

LIGHTING:
Warm amber room lighting combined with subtle cool-blue television light falling naturally across the front of the woman’s face, sweater, and remote.

MOOD:
Cozy, intriguing, cinematic, and realistic—the quiet moment immediately before something magical happens.

CONTINUITY DETAILS:
One woman only. One black remote only. Brown leather sofa. Warm floor lamp. Identical gray outfit from the character sheet. Preserve the exact room layout for a matching final frame.

AVOID:
Television behind the woman, television beside the sofa, reversed room geometry, woman looking away from the screen, remote pointing away from the television, camera behind the woman’s head, rear-view composition, obstructed face, extra people, mirrors, reflections resembling another person, magical effects outside the screen, distorted anatomy, malformed hands, text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks.

Промпт для видео

В разделе Video выберите Seedance 2.0 или 2.5, загрузите начальный кадр и карту персонажа, затем вставьте промпт.

Промпт · видео 20 секунд
REFERENCES:

@image1 — MASTER OPENING AND ENDING SCENE REFERENCE.

Use @image1 as the exact visual reference for the living room, opening composition, final composition, camera angle, lens perspective, brown leather sofa, television, TV stand, floor lamp, furniture placement, lighting, color palette, black remote, pajamas, and slippers.

The television must remain physically IN FRONT OF the woman, directly along her gaze and in the direction of the remote.

Preserve the light beige patterned pajamas and slippers from @image1 throughout the entire video. Do not replace them with a sweater or sweatpants.

@image2 — MASTER CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE.

@image2 is a multi-angle character reference sheet of the same woman. Use it to preserve her exact facial identity, facial structure, eyes, nose, lips, eyebrows, skin tone, hair color, hair length, hair texture, hairstyle, apparent age, height, and natural body proportions throughout every scene and from every camera angle.

REFERENCE PRIORITY:

- Face, hair, skin tone, and body proportions: follow @image2.
- Clothing, slippers, black remote, living room, furniture, lighting, and opening composition: follow @image1.
- Never reproduce the multi-panel layout or studio background from @image2.
- Only one woman appears in the video.

CORE SCENE:

A 20-second dynamic photorealistic live-action fantasy sequence.

The woman from @image2 is relaxing on the sofa from @image1 and trying to change the television channel with the black remote. When she presses the button again, the television pulls her through the screen and into a breathtaking enchanted world.

She travels through a luminous fantasy forest, is launched into the sky by a giant magical flower, lands safely on a friendly white-and-gold sky dragon, flies between floating islands, and finally uses the remote to return to the same living room.

GLOBAL SETTINGS:

Style: Photorealistic live-action fantasy cinema, magical realism, rich natural detail, spectacular environments, realistic fantasy visual effects.

Mood: Curious, adventurous, joyful, breathtaking, and safe. No horror, violence, panic, or threatening imagery.

Camera: Responsive cinematic framing, fluid tracking shots, smooth energetic movement, occasional gentle handheld motion, and close attention to the woman’s facial expressions.

Wardrobe: The exact light beige patterned pajamas and slippers shown in @image1 across all scenes.

Visual effects: Elegant, realistic fantasy effects, luminous particles, natural wind, physically believable hair and fabric movement. No digital glitches, HUD overlays, subtitles, or cartoon styling.

LOCATION MAP:

Location A — 00:00–00:05 and 00:17–00:20:

The exact warm living room from @image1, with the same brown leather sofa, television, TV stand, floor lamp, furniture arrangement, lighting, and camera perspective.

Location B — 00:05–00:10:

An enchanted twilight forest filled with enormous glowing flowers, soft luminous moss, floating golden lights, sparkling streams, and tiny friendly luminous creatures moving between the trees.

Location C — 00:10–00:17:

A vast fantasy sky above luminous clouds, floating green islands, waterfalls pouring into the air, colorful birds, and a majestic friendly white-and-gold sky dragon.

TIMELINE AND STAGES — 20 SECONDS TOTAL:

[00:00–00:04] — THE MALFUNCTIONING REMOTE

Camera:

Begin with a near-exact living recreation of @image1. Preserve its camera position, framing, lens perspective, furniture placement, lighting, and spatial composition.

The woman sits on the left side of the brown leather sofa. The television is on the right side of the frame, physically in front of her.

Action:

The woman from @image2 watches the television and points the black remote directly toward the screen.

The television displays a breathtaking photorealistic fantasy landscape with floating green islands, distant waterfalls, and glowing clouds.

She presses the channel button several times, but nothing changes. She looks briefly at the remote, taps it lightly against her palm, and points it at the television again with mild puzzled frustration.

Her initial movements are subtle and realistic: natural breathing, blinking, small finger movements, and slight changes in television light across her face.

Continuity:

Preserve the exact facial identity from @image2 and the exact pajamas, slippers, remote, sofa, television, and living room from @image1.

[00:04–00:05] — PULLED THROUGH THE TELEVISION

Camera:

Begin a fast continuous cinematic push from the original @image1 camera angle toward the woman and television.

Action:

The woman firmly presses the remote button one more time.

The fantasy image inside the television suddenly becomes brighter and expands beyond the edges of the screen. A warm golden wind rushes from the television into the room, lifting her hair and gently moving her pajamas.

Ribbons of golden light curl around her body.

She grabs the sofa cushion with her free hand while keeping the black remote firmly in the other hand.

The magical force rapidly pulls her off the sofa and directly toward the television. She passes safely through the glowing screen.

Her expression changes from mild frustration to wide-eyed amazement and surprise, but never terror.

Transition:

The camera follows her through the television in one fast continuous movement.

No digital glitch effect, no body distortion, no teleportation cut, and no horror imagery.

[00:05–00:10] — THE ENCHANTED FOREST

Camera:

A fluid medium tracking shot follows the woman as she emerges from a circular ring of golden light.

Action:

The woman from @image2 lands safely on a soft bed of luminous moss in the enchanted twilight forest.

She remains dressed in the exact beige pajamas and slippers from @image1 and still holds the same black remote.

She slowly rises and looks around in astonishment.

Enormous glowing flowers unfold as she walks past them. Tiny friendly luminous creatures race playfully around her slippers. Golden lights float between the trees, and a sparkling stream flows nearby.

A glowing blue butterfly circles her once and lands gently on the black remote.

The woman looks closely at the butterfly with delighted curiosity. She carefully presses another button on the remote.

A giant flower beneath her feet opens like a soft springy platform and gently launches her upward.

Her surprise turns into joyful laughter.

Dialogue:

The woman softly exclaims in amazement:

{Wow…}

Transition at 00:10:

The camera follows her upward through the canopy of glowing leaves and bursts into the bright open sky.

[00:10–00:17] — FLIGHT THROUGH THE FANTASY SKY

Camera:

A sweeping aerial tracking shot stays close enough to preserve the woman’s recognizable facial identity from @image2 while revealing the enormous magical landscape around her.

Action:

The woman rises through the glowing forest canopy and lands safely on the broad back of a majestic white-and-gold sky dragon.

The dragon is elegant, gentle, and friendly, with kind expressive eyes. It must never appear aggressive or threatening.

The dragon soars between floating green islands and beneath waterfalls suspended in the clouds.

Flocks of colorful birds fly alongside them.

The woman holds onto a soft golden ridge on the dragon’s back with one hand and keeps the same black remote securely in her other hand.

She laughs with excitement as the wind moves naturally through her hair and pajamas. Her slippers remain securely on her feet.

The dragon makes a graceful turn above a glowing valley of clouds.

At 00:16, the remote begins blinking with a soft warm light.

The woman looks at the remote, then looks at the beautiful fantasy world around her. She smiles reluctantly, realizing that it is time to return home.

She presses the button.

Transition at 00:17:

A circular golden portal shaped like the television screen opens ahead. The friendly dragon flies smoothly toward the portal, and the woman passes through it.

[00:17–00:20] — RETURN TO THE SAME LIVING ROOM

Camera:

Return to the exact living room and camera perspective shown in @image1.

Match the original camera height, angle, framing, lens perspective, sofa position, television position, floor lamp, furniture arrangement, and lighting.

Action:

The woman gently drops back onto the same area of the brown leather sofa.

She wears the same beige pajamas and slippers and holds the same black remote.

She does not need to return to the exact original body pose. Her posture is now slightly energized and naturally disheveled from the adventure.

She breathes quickly from excitement, lowers the remote toward her lap, and looks down at it with delighted disbelief.

The same tiny glowing blue butterfly flies out from the edge of her pajama sleeve, lands briefly on the remote, and dissolves into a few delicate golden particles.

The woman watches the fading light and smiles in quiet amazement.

The television remains in front of her in the same position as in @image1. It now displays a calm neutral image with no fantasy world, readable text, or logos.

The ending must clearly feel like a return to the exact same physical room shown at the beginning.

SOUND AND AUDIO:

[00:00–00:04]:

Soft living-room ambience, muffled television sound, quiet plastic remote clicks, subtle fabric movement.

[00:04–00:05]:

Rising magical wind, warm resonant chime, sofa creak, soft rushing sound as the woman is pulled through the screen.

[00:05–00:10]:

Enchanted forest ambience, delicate bells, flowing water, fluttering wings, playful creature sounds, unfolding flowers, and the woman’s quiet delighted laughter.

[00:10–00:17]:

Expansive orchestral swell, rushing wind, distant waterfalls, bird wings, and the gentle melodic call of the sky dragon.

[00:17–00:20]:

Sudden return to quiet living-room ambience, soft landing on the sofa cushions, excited breathing, and one final delicate magical chime.

INVARIANT CHECKLIST:

- @image2 controls the woman’s exact identity in every scene.
- @image1 controls the living room, wardrobe, slippers, black remote, lighting, and opening and ending compositions.
- Preserve the woman’s face during movement, side profiles, wide shots, aerial shots, and transitions.
- The woman wears the exact beige patterned pajamas and slippers from @image1 throughout the entire video.
- The same black remote remains in her hand during every transition.
- The television remains physically in front of the woman in the living-room scenes.
- Never mirror or reverse the living-room composition.
- The woman enters one continuous fantasy world through the television.
- Fantasy creatures are beautiful, friendly, and non-threatening.
- Maintain realistic anatomy, natural hands, correct fingers, realistic skin, and physically believable hair and fabric movement.
- No face morphing, identity changes, wardrobe changes, duplicate character, extra limbs, distorted hands, battles, weapons, horror, injury, text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks.
